evidence.cause: Deferred nonblocking TCP half-close jobs retained physical socket leases until a separately scheduled reaper ran. Sequential connections could exhaust quota on one CPU.
evidence.fix: Synchronously half-close nonblocking sockets and release leases. Admit cleanup into the owner shutdown wait group under its lock; serialize final FD close and removal. Remove reaper/queue. Keep real physical/published limits.
